notes: 50 new curated edges drafted to extend data/relationships.json from ~108 to ~158 entries. Style/voice/fields match existing entries. Estimates given as ranges; no fabricated key_events. NOW->Enterprise.what_flows: Now Assist GenAI agents inside ServiceNow ITSM/ITOM/HRSD workflows for Fortune 2000 customers
NOW->Enterprise.deal_basis: NOW FY25 subscription revenue ~$11B; Now Assist Pro Plus SKU is fastest-growing add-on disclosed in IR commentary.
NOW->Enterprise.alternatives: SAP Joule, Salesforce Agentforce, Workday + custom GenAI builds.
NOW->Enterprise.trend: Growing fast; AI SKU attach rate the #1 narrative on NOW earnings calls.

CRM->Enterprise.what_flows: Agentforce autonomous AI agents + Einstein GenAI bundled into Sales/Service/Marketing Clouds + Data Cloud
CRM->Enterprise.deal_basis: CRM FY26 (Jan 2026) revenue guide ~$38B; Agentforce monetization via Flex Credits ramping in 2026.
CRM->Enterprise.alternatives: MSFT Dynamics 365 + Copilot, HubSpot, Oracle Fusion.
CRM->Enterprise.trend: Mixed — top-line stable but Agentforce uptake slower than initial guidance.

ADBE->Creators.what_flows: Firefly GenAI image/video models + Sensei inside Creative Cloud + Express; commercial-safe generation licenses
ADBE->Creators.deal_basis: ADBE FY25 (Nov 2025) revenue ~$21B; Digital Media segment ~$15B, GenAI now embedded across all CC apps.
ADBE->Creators.alternatives: Midjourney, OpenAI Sora, Runway, Canva — strong substitution risk on the prosumer edge.
ADBE->Creators.trend: Stable to slightly growing; AI substitution risk a recurring bear thesis.

SAP->Enterprise.what_flows: Joule AI copilot + RISE/GROW S/4HANA cloud + Datasphere data fabric for ERP-anchored GenAI
SAP->Enterprise.deal_basis: SAP FY25 cloud revenue ~$20B (out of total ~$36B); Joule attached to all RISE migrations.
SAP->Enterprise.alternatives: Oracle Fusion ERP, Workday, MSFT Dynamics.

CRWD->Enterprise.what_flows: Falcon platform endpoint + cloud + identity security; Charlotte AI agentic SOC analyst
CRWD->Enterprise.deal_basis: CRWD FY26 ARR ~$4.5B; Charlotte AI module attaching to ~25%+ of new logos.
CRWD->Enterprise.alternatives: PANW Cortex XSIAM, MSFT Defender, SentinelOne.
CRWD->Enterprise.trend: Growing; recovery post Jul-2024 outage incident largely complete.

PANW->Enterprise.what_flows: Prisma + Cortex XSIAM platforms with Precision AI for SOC + Prisma AIRS for runtime LLM/agent security
PANW->Enterprise.deal_basis: PANW FY25 (Jul 2025) revenue ~$8.7B; platformization narrative driving cross-sell.

ZS->Enterprise.what_flows: Zero-trust SASE platform + AI-driven SOC automation for distributed workforces and AI agent traffic
ZS->Enterprise.alternatives: PANW Prisma Access, NET, Netskope (private), Cisco SASE.
ZS->Enterprise.trend: Growing; AI workload egress traffic a new pricing vector.

DDOG->Hyperscalers.what_flows: Observability + LLM Observability product covering GPU fleet, model latency, hallucination metrics for hyperscaler-hosted AI workloads
DDOG->Hyperscalers.deal_basis: DDOG FY25 revenue ~$3.6B; ~80% of usage on AWS + Azure infrastructure (DDOG hosting fees a meaningful cost line for hyperscalers' AI customers).
DDOG->Hyperscalers.trend: Growing fast; LLM observability SKU was a 2024 launch with strong attach.

MDB->Enterprise.what_flows: Atlas document DB + Atlas Vector Search for RAG pipelines; AI-native data layer for application developers
MDB->Enterprise.deal_basis: MDB FY26 (Jan 2026) revenue ~$2B; Atlas Vector Search GA driving net-new AI workloads.
MDB->Enterprise.trend: Growing; consumption-based model exposes them to AI workload bursts.

ESTC->Enterprise.what_flows: Elasticsearch + vector search + ES|QL semantic queries for enterprise RAG + observability bundles

NET->Enterprise.what_flows: Workers AI inference at edge + AI Gateway + R2 object storage for low-latency model serving across 300+ PoPs
NET->Enterprise.deal_basis: NET FY25 revenue ~$1.9B; Workers AI launched 2023 monetizing across 2024-25.
NET->Enterprise.trend: Growing; edge inference is the differentiated story.

SNOW->Enterprise.what_flows: Snowflake Data Cloud + Cortex AI (in-warehouse LLM functions) + Snowpark Container Services for AI inference adjacent to enterprise data
SNOW->Enterprise.deal_basis: SNOW FY26 (Jan 2026) product revenue guide ~$4.3B; Cortex consumption disclosed as one of fastest-growing workloads.
SNOW->Enterprise.alternatives: Databricks (private), GCP BigQuery + Vertex, AWS Redshift + Bedrock, MSFT Fabric.
SNOW->Enterprise.trend: Growing; data-gravity moat keeping enterprise AI inference inside Snowflake.

NVDA->Auto.what_flows: DRIVE Thor / Orin SoCs + DGX training systems for ADAS + autonomous-vehicle programs at major auto OEMs
NVDA->Auto.deal_basis: NVDA auto segment revenue ~$1.7B FY26 with disclosed >$25B 6-yr pipeline (Mercedes, JLR, BYD, Volvo, Lucid).
NVDA->Auto.alternatives: QCOM Snapdragon Ride, MBLY EyeQ, Tesla internal silicon.
NVDA->Auto.trend: Growing; auto is NVDA's 'next vertical' commentary.

QCOM->AAPL.what_flows: 5G modem chips (X75/X80) for iPhone — multi-year supply agreement extended through 2026/27
QCOM->AAPL.deal_basis: Sep 2023 supply agreement: covers iPhones launched through 2026; AAPL modem in-house program (Sinope) repeatedly delayed.
QCOM->AAPL.alternatives: Apple internal modem (C1 partially shipping in lower iPhones, full ramp delayed); MediaTek (not used in iPhone).
QCOM->AAPL.trend: Declining medium-term as Apple insources modem; near-term stable.

ON->Auto.what_flows: SiC power devices (EliteSiC) + image sensors (Hyperlux) for EV traction inverters + ADAS cameras at major auto OEMs
ON->Auto.deal_basis: ON FY25 automotive revenue ~$3.5B (~50% of total); long-term SiC supply agreements with VW, BMW, Stellantis, NIO.
ON->Auto.trend: Mixed — SiC demand cooling on slower EV ramps, but ON gaining share.

ADI->DELL.what_flows: Precision PMICs + signal-chain analog for server platforms incl. AI compute power delivery
ADI->DELL.trend: Growing slowly with AI server PMIC content per box increasing.

TXN->Industrial.what_flows: Analog + embedded MCU/processors across factory automation, motor drives, building systems, medical
TXN->Industrial.deal_basis: TXN FY25 industrial end-market revenue ~$10B (~65% of total before recovery).
TXN->Industrial.trend: Mixed; industrial cycle troughing late 2024 with slow recovery 2025-26.

MPWR->NVDA.what_flows: Vertical Power Modules (VPM) + multi-phase controllers for high-density 48V→1V GPU board power delivery
MPWR->NVDA.deal_basis: MPWR enterprise/data center revenue ~$1.3B FY25; NVDA is single largest customer, disclosed concentration risk.
MPWR->NVDA.trend: Growing fast; NVDA Blackwell power density (1200W+) accelerated MPWR content.

VICR->NVDA.what_flows: Factorized Power 48V Direct-to-Chip modules for B200/B300 GPU boards (alongside MPWR)
VICR->NVDA.trend: Growing; design wins disclosed across Blackwell + Rubin.

GEV->DLR.what_flows: Gas turbines for on-site captive generation + grid transformers for hyperscale campuses contracted via DLR
GEV->DLR.alternatives: Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, Caterpillar (smaller scale).

GEV->EQIX.what_flows: Gas turbines + medium-voltage switchgear + grid-tie systems for xScale hyperscale builds

NEE->Hyperscalers.what_flows: Renewable PPAs (wind + solar) + battery storage across multiple ISOs for MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN, ORCL
NEE->Hyperscalers.deal_basis: NEE largest US renewables developer; ~10 GW+ corporate PPAs with hyperscalers signed 2022-25, MSFT a top 3 customer.
NEE->Hyperscalers.alternatives: AES, Engie (private), independent developers; in-territory utilities.
NEE->Hyperscalers.trend: Growing fast; NEE positioning as default hyperscaler renewables counterparty.

ETR->META.what_flows: Louisiana electricity supply for META Richland Parish 4-million-sq-ft AI campus (~2 GW peak); approved gas plant additions
ETR->META.deal_basis: Dec 2024 announcement: $10B META campus; ETR filed for 1.5 GW of new gas-fired capacity Apr 2025.
ETR->META.key_event: META Richland Parish announcement Dec 2024; ETR new-gas filing Apr 2025.

SO->Hyperscalers.what_flows: Georgia Power electricity from Vogtle 3+4 nuclear + new gas; MSFT/GOOGL/META Georgia campuses

OKE->Utilities.what_flows: Natural gas transportation + NGL services to Permian + Mid-Continent gas-fired generation supplying AI data-center load

WMB->Hyperscalers.what_flows: Transco mainline gas delivery to Atlantic + Southeast data-center clusters (Virginia, Carolinas, Georgia)
WMB->Hyperscalers.deal_basis: WMB disclosed >10 GW of new power gen projects connected to its system through 2030.
WMB->Hyperscalers.trend: Growing fast on Southeast data-center gas demand.

AGX->IPP.what_flows: EPC construction of new combined-cycle gas plants for independent power producers serving AI campus load
AGX->IPP.deal_basis: AGX backlog reached record ~$2B FY25 (Jan 2025); majority is gas-fired power plant EPC tied to data-center IPP demand.
AGX->IPP.key_event: AGX backlog hit record on multiple Trumbull/Texas gas-plant EPC awards FY25.

POWL->DLR.what_flows: Custom medium-voltage switchgear for utility-scale data-center substations + on-site power distribution
POWL->DLR.trend: Growing fast; POWL backlog +>100% YoY in 2024.

KBR->Government.what_flows: Mission-IT + facilities engineering for DOD/DOE programs incl. nuclear + classified data-center support
KBR->Government.deal_basis: KBR FY25 revenue ~$7.7B; ~70% Government Solutions segment.

FLR->Utilities.what_flows: EPC for nuclear (Vogtle support, SMR programs) + advanced manufacturing + power-plant builds
FLR->Utilities.trend: Growing on nuclear + AI-infrastructure capex cycle.

ACM->Hyperscalers.what_flows: Engineering + construction management for data-center site development + utility interconnections

STRL->Hyperscalers.deal_basis: STRL E-Infrastructure segment revenue grew ~50%+ in 2023-25 driven by data-center site work.

PRIM->Utilities.what_flows: Pipeline + power transmission + telecom EPC for utility customers serving AI load growth

VEOEY->TSM.deal_basis: Veolia disclosed multiple long-term semi water-treatment contracts in Taiwan + Arizona; fab-water demand a stated growth vector.

RMBS->MU.what_flows: Memory interface IP (DDR5 RCD/DB, MRDIMM, HBM controllers, CXL) licensed + chip products for server memory subsystems
RMBS->MU.deal_basis: RMBS FY25 revenue ~$600M with majority from server DRAM interface chips (RCD/DB) used in DDR5 + MRDIMM platforms.

GFS->Auto.what_flows: Specialty foundry (12LP+/22FDX) RF + automotive silicon for ADAS, radar, body-control + RF front-end

GFS->Auto.alternatives: TSM specialty nodes, UMC, STMicro, SOIGY-based fabs.

UMC->Fabless.what_flows: Mature-node (14/22/28/40nm) foundry capacity for fabless analog/RF/IoT/auto customers (NXP, Renesas, MediaTek, etc.)

UMC->Fabless.alternatives: TSM mature nodes, GFS, SMIC (China), Tower (now INTC Foundry).

AMKR->NVDA.alternatives: TSM in-house CoWoS, ASX advanced packaging.

AMKR->AAPL.what_flows: Advanced flip-chip + system-in-package for A-series + M-series silicon at Arizona facility (anchor tenant)
AMKR->AAPL.deal_basis: AAPL disclosed as anchor tenant for AMKR's Arizona Peoria advanced packaging facility (Nov 2023).
AMKR->AAPL.trend: Growing; first US-packaged Apple silicon expected from this facility post-2027.
AMKR->AAPL.key_event: AMKR-AAPL Arizona Peoria anchor agreement Nov 2023.

HON->Quantum.what_flows: Quantinuum (HON majority stake) trapped-ion H1/H2 quantum systems sold to enterprise + government research customers; quantum networking R&D

HON->Quantum.alternatives: IONQ (also trapped ion), IBM Quantum (superconducting), QuEra (private, neutral atom).
HON->Quantum.trend: Growing slowly; revenue tiny but strategic and HON has commitments to scale Quantinuum independently.

IBM->Government.what_flows: IBM Quantum systems + access subscriptions for government labs (Argonne, Oak Ridge, RIKEN, AIST, etc.) + watsonx classical AI deployments
IBM->Government.alternatives: Microsoft Azure Quantum, AWS Braket, Quantinuum direct.
IBM->Government.trend: Growing; Quantum System Two installations + new national-lab deals in 2024-25.

INTC->Quantum.what_flows: Tunnel Falls 12-qubit silicon-spin test chip + cryo-CMOS controller research distributed to academic + DOE research partners
INTC->Quantum.alternatives: Various academic + private silicon-spin programs (Quantum Motion, Diraq).

IONQ->Government.what_flows: Trapped-ion quantum hardware + cloud-access subscriptions for AFRL, USC/AFRL hub, DOE labs, and allied government programs
IONQ->Government.deal_basis: IONQ FY25 revenue ~$45M; AFRL contract + AQ Pioneer system sales the bulk of disclosed bookings.
IONQ->Government.alternatives: HON Quantinuum (trapped ion), IBM Quantum, Rigetti, QuEra (private).
IONQ->Government.trend: Growing; quantum-government remains the only meaningful revenue line.
